name: Family Secrets
description: Ceylin is a fierce, rule-bending defence attorney whose father was wrongly imprisoned — for her, justice always comes before the law. Ilgaz is a by-the-book prosecutor who believes the two are the same thing. When his brother is accused of murder, he has no choice but to go to her for help. What follows is a gripping cat-and-mouse legal thriller built on brilliant opposing chemistry — winner of the International Emmy for Best Telenovela in 2023.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ceylin and Ilgaz, a prosecutor and lawyer, are two people of law whose methods are on opposite poles while they are fighting on the same path. Endlessly clashing and testing each other until they come together to fight a common battle. When Ilgaz catches a murder case in which his brother ends up involved, he must work together with Ceylin to solve the case.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The Erguvan family is shattered by the death of their little girl. It is Ceylin's duty to endure the pain of her mother, sister, and father, in addition to living through her own pain whilst fighting with the last drop of her blood to find her sister's murderer.  With every piece of evidence, a new suspect is added to the list. The questions are increasing.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The newest piece of evidence stuns both Ceylin and Ilgaz. Whilst Ilgaz tries to cope with the shock of the lie his father told him; Ceylin pushes the boundaries of Ilgaz and Eren as well as herself in order to find İnci's murderer. Ceylin continues to hide from her family that she is defending Çınar. As the curtain on the murder and the life that İnci hides from everyone is lifted, both Ceylin and Ilgaz will find themselves drifting at unexpected turns, and both will have to learn through painful experiences that their families have secrets that they cannot predict.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Witnessing Zafer's interrogation, Ceylin is faced with facts about İnci that she cannot handle. As both Ilgaz and Ceylin implement their own plans, the sense of trust they are trying to cultivate against each other will be tested again. Trying to reach the truth brings them closer over time, and causes walls to rise between them and their families. Will they be able to stand against these walls without collapsing?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Every clue that emerges brings us closer to the truth step by step; open the loops one by one. However, the knots we untie do not always bring happiness, in the end we have to go through great pain. Pain brings other knots; they also put us on more difficult paths. We understand that; The knots that life throws on our destiny will never end...While both Ceylin and Ilgaz struggle to find İnci's killer, they are tested by their families and loved ones. Ceylin is about to irreversibly lose her family, and Ilgaz, his brother Çınar. Moreover, Pars is determined to put completely different obstacles in front of them. The intersecting paths of Ceylin and Ilgaz are now about to enter a completely different and sharper turn. The adventure they embark on while searching for İnci's murderer will lead them to the truth as they overcome the difficulties they face together. However, this fact will create a much bigger earthquake for both families, but more importantly, the two of them.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It is now known that the person who killed her brother is Engin, and Ceylin is in indescribable pain. The anger rising in her is unbearable, and Ceylin is determined to kill Engin. Although Ilgaz is right in his intuitions, he cannot stand Ceylin's collapse and makes a decision. He finds his own way, albeit harshly, to calm Ceylin down so that they can prove that Engin is the killer. Pars is determined to put aside even his feelings for Ceylin and accuse her of collecting evidence irregularly and ban her from the profession. Ceylin comes face to face with Ilgaz. While Yekta struggles to clear his son's name, Zafer is devastated by the release of Çınar and comes to the brink of a new turn. His decision will change the fate of the two families forever. While Ceylin and Ilgaz are chasing the evidence that will convict Engin, they also look for ways to get out of the difficult situation that Pars has put them in. Will Ilgaz give up on his own rules and lie for Ceylin?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The news of the marriage of Ceylin and Ilgaz disappoints Pars and Neva. Pars is not at all satisfied with the obstruction of the investigation. Moreover, he, like his brother Neva, is heartbroken. Pars is determined not to let the investigation go. Zafer is about to embark on an irreversible path of revenge with the gun he pulled on Çınar. Will Çınar be able to convince Zafer that he is innocent? Or will this weapon drawn cause a new and great chasm to be opened between the two families? Ceylin is having difficulty pretending that she has nothing against Engin, the murderer of her brother. Ceylin and Ilgaz take new risks when they are looking for ways to put Engin on remand without telling anyone. However, on the one hand, they have to be faster than Yekta, who is doing everything he can to exonerate his son, and elsewhere, they have to fight Pars, who may stand in their way at any moment. Will Ilgaz and Ceylin be able to prove the truth this time?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Ceylin thinks that she has come to the end of her struggle, which she had to keep secret from everyone, from the moment she learned that Engin was the murderer of her brother. He has a big and painful confrontation with Engin. Although Ceylin thinks she can handle it without Ilgaz's help; Thanks to Ilgaz's foresight, events will develop in a completely different way. Metin Çınar comes to the realization that his life reached a breaking point from the moment he came home with bloody hands. Now a very difficult choice awaits him, will he be on the side of his son or on the side of honesty? While trying to recover after the marriage of Ilgaz and Ceylin, Pars decides to try another way in his approach to them and Eren. Ceylin and Ilgaz are forced to cooperate again in order to win the war they openly entered with Yekta. While looking for new ways to prove that Engin is the murderer, they both realize that some feelings that they can't even admit to themselves are blooming.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: After Engin accuses Yekta, Ceylin and Ilgaz realize that they need to act urgently. Ceylin tries to get Engin to enter the prison irreversibly by the methods suggested to her by Ilgaz... However, this road is full of bumps that will emotionally traumatize Ceylin again. Pars comes face to face with the possibility of revealing an important and big secret about himself as a result of Yekta's accusation and shows a very different attitude than usual to prevent it. Metin encounters an unexpected surprise while trying to find the body of Zafer who disappeared. Yekta, on the other hand, is determined to make him pay for Laçin's stance on Engin's side. Ilgaz and Ceylin get closer to each other emotionally, moreover, this closeness turns into a game-changer for both of them. While trying to finalize Engin's conviction, they have to answer new questions created by feelings they can't even admit to themselves.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The difficult decision that Ceylin made to put distance between her and Ilgaz is becoming painful for the both of them. Further shocks that will be added to Ilgaz's resentment towards Ceylin will push them to the brink of a big conflict. Engin's trial as a prisoner is about to turn into a new beginning, rather than an end, and a series of events that deeply affect everyone. While planning his vast new goal, a surprise person appears who will help him on this path. Pars is forced to face his secret, which he hides from everyone. Metin tries to protect Cinar on the one hand and struggles with Merdan, who is unquestioningly involved in their lives on the other hand. Gul, on the other hand, is determined to do everything he can to make amends for his mistakes. As Ilgaz and Ceylin collide on opposite lanes in a new case, a fact that will put them both in a big predicament hits their faces at a moment they never expected. They don't know is that the tip of the iceberg.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Ceylin and Ilgaz, after the voice message sent, realize that the nightmare they thought was over has actually just begun. Engin has a plan for everyone he believes has harmed him, especially them. Ceylin and Ilgaz stand at the very center of this spiral. Eren, Pars, Çınar, and Yekta begin to try to solve the whole puzzle that confronts them, without letting anyone know. However, this process will leave them all with big questions and surprises that they did not expect. Will they be able to control the anger that rises from a deep place inside them? Or will this anger cause a great fire? While Ilgaz and Ceylin are dealing with Engin's threats on the one hand and the case they are parties to on the other, the knot that their past was tied to reappears. While this situation leaves them in the arms of a cruel "if only"; Now, very difficult choices await them both.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Ceylin is shaken by the unexpected hesitation from Ilgaz when they are closest to each other. Will irreversibly break the bond that Ilgaz and Ceylin are trying to establish, or will it make it even stronger? Engin's threats, who are completely cornered, turn everyone's world upside down. In this rapidly shrinking time, where everyone tests themselves, roads, separations, and unexpected unions will emerge that will prevent Engin from making a move. Will Engin's little sparks that hurt everyone cause a big fire or will it be extinguished? Despite everything, Ilgaz and Ceylin have to act together professionally in the case they are parties to. As the countdown continues, an unexpected development will lead everyone, especially the two of them, to a new path.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Ilgaz and Ceylin realized that they were much stronger when they acted together due to the fact that they were parties and fell side by side to solve the case. However, Ceylin is infuriated when Engin shoots himself over Parla with a new move. Ceylin is now determined to use her own methods to stop Engin. Engin's carefully prepared plan for everyone has come to an end. While he was progressing in harmony with the plan he had established, someone tried to leave him out of their game. In this tense process where everyone is tested with their loved ones, surprising and surprising unions begin to form… Will Ilgaz and Ceylin, who are getting closer to each other on every road they take, choose to suppress the feelings that grow in their hearts despite all the impossibility, or will they choose to surrender to them? Moreover, when life has prepared them a new test of a magnitude that they have never encountered before...

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Ilgaz, who could not get any news from Ceylin, went crazy. For Ilgaz, who knows Ceylin well, it is not difficult at all to think like him and make sense of what he does. On the one hand, the security forces, who are legally alarmed by Engin's escape, on the other hand, mobilize to deal with the loss of Ceylin. Sleepless nights and days await them all. Before the puzzle of who poisoned Engin is solved, the question of who may have been kidnapped has now arisen. In this process, while some of them make a partnership of fate for the sake of their secrets, for others, the end of the road seems obvious. Ceylin, who has been accustomed to overcoming all difficulties on her own, is now in a knot that is difficult to get out of. Will the fate that brings him side by side with Ilgaz every time somehow, this time, will be able to clamp the two of them together with unbreakable ropes?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Ceylin's pre-trial detention decision shocked Ilgaz and the Erguvan family. Although Ilgaz still believes that Ceylin is innocent, Ceylin experiences great indecision and inconsistencies about the moments when she cannot put the pieces together in her mind. Yekta Tilmen is about to declare a clear war by mobilizing all his strength with the death of his son Engin. This war of justice, which was waged through Engin, is the harbinger of many surprise confrontations along with new partnerships. Stuck between his emotions and justice, Ilgaz now has to grapple with a new problem as well as this dilemma. His quest to find the real criminal who goes at full speed to save Ceylin will leave him in a position he has never encountered before in his life.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Ilgaz, torn between the woman he loves and his profession, made an unexpected decision and surprised everyone. What kind of attitude will Ceylin, who is unaware of the predicaments of Ilgaz, who believes in her more than anyone, even himself, take? Believing that all the evidence points to Ceylin for killing his son, Yekta Tilmen rallies the troops to go after her. He will not hesitate to make moves for the sake of achieving the justice he believes in, even if it is at the expense of bringing everyone against him. Ceylin, who has to stay together with many injured women, struggles to remember the murder. She vacillates between being indifferent to the story of these women. Moreover, she's unaware of the swords drawn and the newly formed fronts in the world outside...

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: With Ilgaz's guidance, some things are starting to become clear for Ceylin, who started to remember the details of the night Engin died. As clues emerge that will clear Ceylin's suspicions, Ilgaz wants to take confident steps on the road to Ceylin's innocence. However, great obstacles await him. Evidence in favor of Ceylin, which is increasingly confusing his son's file, causes Yekta to become more aggressive. While Seda stays close to Yekta to fulfill the task given by Merdan, Çınar again takes a risk and agrees to act with Serdar and gets involved in a dangerous plan. Moreover, this time he is not alone. A new path appears on the horizon for Ilgaz and Ceylin, who realize that they need each other to get up stronger whenever they fall. But this time, this path, which lies in the shadow of bigger decisions, is about to take them to a new threshold.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: For Ilgaz, who started walking with the woman he loved, a new path was opened in front of him that he had never experienced before professionally. Although Ceylin's presence and the hand she extends to him on this path give him peace and security, nothing is as he sees from behind the lectern. Yekta, who is working hard to find out about his son's murder, is determined to track down the betrayal in his marriage. The time has come to establish new communication with Neva, with whom Pars has not settled since her arrival. The Erguvan family, on the other hand, is unaware of the plan Merdan has prepared for them while dealing with problems that they cannot solve on their own. A surprise new case awaits Ilgaz and Ceylin, who are now walking together professionally. Years go by the tightrope, with the cevval's lawyer Ceylin, straight out, the old prosecutor who doesn't know anything to lie, the new lawyer Ilgaz; The days are waiting for them to get to know each other again.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Ceylin and Ilgaz, who can easily overcome any problem when together, are faced with a problem they never expected. This comradeship, which gives them strength, seems to cause other troubles, albeit unintentionally. Hard days and nights await Prosecutor Pars, whose sense of justice is indisputable. The confusion between the facts he knows to be true and the statements made will force him to choose between himself and his sense of justice. Yekta Tilmen, who struggles with both Lâçin's betrayal and his son's case, awaits new evidence that will strengthen his hand on both issues. Ilgaz, who does not do his best to acquit Ceylin, has also fallen into a formation that defames him. The process of acquittal, which started as a legal war, is about to turn into a real war by revealing the fronts. Although Ilgaz and Ceylin are used to handling everything properly without leaking, the mud thrown seems to pollute the area.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The indictment against Ceylin shocked everyone, especially Ceylin. Ilgaz is waiting right next to Ceylin, who thinks that she has been hit from where she did not expect, outstretched her hands to overcome this problem together. While Pars is already tightly squeezed from everywhere in the battle to find justice as soon as possible, he is about to receive unexpected blows. Moreover, Yekta Tilmen, who can go to any lengths to ensure his own justice, is on the other side... Metin Amir and Eren's commissioner, who are engaged in an all-out struggle to find the mole inside the criminal bureau, are waiting for a surprising development. Ilgaz, who does not do his best to acquit Ceylin, is waiting for the most difficult case in his life. In this "war of justice", where the fronts are getting sharper, a journey that will shock Ilgaz and Ceylin, who are fighting side by side, awaits.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Niyazi's death creates a shock effect for Ilgaz, who wanders around his borders in order to acquit Ceylin. Both Ilgaz and Ceylin were caught in the middle of a big case both legally and in terms of conscience. Yekta realizes that the defenses of Ilgaz and Ceylin are weakening after Niyazi, who, as it turned out, ended his life. Now it is his turn to gather information and reinforce it with evidence in order to be more committed to his cause. However, they do not yet know that an unexpected move that will shock everyone will come from their side. A difficult preparation process awaits Ilgaz, who puts forth all his might to win the case. On the one hand, he has to stay within the legal rules while trying to restrain Ceylin, who is on his own, after the clues to defeat Yekta. However, at the end of this road, both of them will be faced with new information they did not expect and come to the brink of a difficult decision.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Ilgaz and Ceylin, on the one hand, continue Ceylin's journey of being acquitted, on the other hand, they are faced with Yekta, who reveals the battle axes. Every step of the way, they have a ruthless enemy who was there before them... Pars gets into a corner when Ilgaz and Ceylin, whom he believed and helped so far, spread to his relatives within the scope of the expanding case. At this point, Pars will be shaken by the new evidence and confession and will have difficulty balancing his own scales of justice.Young people, who find themselves in a network that they have never met, are faced with tougher and more difficult times as they try to climb out of it. The big trial day awaits Ilgaz and Ceylin, who are strong and invincible when they are together in search of justice. As the ranks of the trial become clear, the new evidence that will emerge will shock both sides, and the decision to be made after the court will be a turning point for the relationship between the two.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The video from Engin created a shock effect for Ceylin, who has just gotten over the tension of the trial. In the light of new information and surprising developments that will perhaps radically change the trial process, will Ilgaz be able to continue defending Ceylin with the same faith as on the first day? Yekta Tilmen, who was defeated as a result of the war he waged, struggles with a situation he has never encountered before in his life. However, Yekta, who continues his war without slowing down with the belief that better days will come, is waiting for an unexpected development. Pars, who has been dealing with Engin's case for a long time, is waiting for a brand new case at the courthouse. Difficult days await the duo of Ilgaz and Ceylin, who have managed to get out of every difficult situation they have been in so far. While these two different souls are trying to stay together under all circumstances, they will suddenly find themselves at a difficult turning point.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: A great stalemate awaits the relations of Ceylin and Ilgaz. For the duo, who have complemented each other perfectly until now, their differences this time seem to cause a major crisis. And while they were dragged into a brand new case, which they did not expect... Engin's video turned upside down the theories that everyone thought so far and changed many known ones. On the other hand, Çınar and Serdar, who constantly manage to cause trouble, are in an irreversible stalemate this time. It is as if the struggle of the young people who are under this deadlock to be questioned and to reveal the truth will spread to everyone. Ilgaz and Ceylin, who have always been walking on the path of justice they believed in, are now waiting for the tests they have to pass for their love on the way they walk each other.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Ilgaz deciphered the message Engin sent to Ceylin and told her. Ceylin's unmistakable denial of this message is that her father's disembarkation date has come. Ilgaz, who is after the truth, has already started research on Zafer. For Serdar, who has kept the secrets he has accumulated as an exit ticket, it is now time to use some of them as leverage. It is only a matter of time before this information turns into a weapon that will hit the other side on the Yekta Tilmen front. Will the dossier they were assigned to look at together be able to bring Pars and Derya, who have very different perspectives, together on the same path? Another tough test awaits Ilgaz and Ceylin, who have crossed difficult roads many times. This is the sharpest corner for the future of the two of them, and unpredictable difficult days await them.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Ceylin recognized the clothes at one sight; The body, whose identity is unknown, belongs to her father. Not being able to see her father, for whom she had hoped until now, has shaken her deeply, but Ilgaz Kaya is standing next to her, embracing her. The loss of Zafer has moved many stones in the Kaya family, as it did in the Erguvan family. While trying to deal with the shock of such a loss, all the trumps are on Yekta Tilmen, who is starting to beat the war drums, and her maneuvers on this subject are curious. Everyone mobilized to shed light on the murder for Ceylin and her household, who are trying to cope with her pain. For Ceylin, who is patiently waiting for the truth to be revealed, help will come from an unexpected place. Ilgaz, who is trying to make sense of the dead land on his own family, is also devastated by the mourning of the woman he loves. This unexpected loss, which life has presented to them and knitted with many mistakes, will open the door of a new era for the duo.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Ceylin, whose family is shattered, sees Metin, who she thinks wants to support her, as her new family. However, this false balance is being destroyed day by day and the transparent veil on it is about to open rapidly and inexorably. Will the Ilgaz-Ceylin couple be able to come out of this wreckage successfully? Eren, who cannot understand how Metin is involved in the incident, is waiting for the most difficult days of his life. At this point, a surprise cooperation awaits him at the end of the day. Yekta, who knows every detail of Zafer's murder and enjoys knowing to the end by not telling anyone, has an unexpected visitor. Ceylin's emotional state worries everyone, who is in a great mourning period with her untimely losses. Ilgaz is ready to hold Ceylin's hand tighter than ever before and embark on a new path. However, the sound of the chains attached to the feet of both of them gradually began to be heard…

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Thanks to the clues he found, Ilgaz reached the ultimate truth by himself, and this truth devastated him. Moreover, Ceylin, who is at the heart of this truth, is in a devastated state and needs Ilgaz to get up from where she fell. What attitude will Ilgaz have towards the woman he loves while he has the knowledge of this great secret? The secret investigation of Pars and Eren duo came to light. When their paths crossed with Ilgaz, all the pieces fell into place for them, too. Now, with the issues that everyone has to face, who will take what stance? Ceylin, who wants to hold on to life tightly, has made the first big decisions in her life. Ceylin, who sees Ilgaz as her closest source of power in these decisions, is still unaware of the facts that may emerge. Will it be possible to continue on the road despite everything?

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Ceylin caught Ilgaz in a way she could never have guessed. Explaining to Ceylin that this big secret belonging to Çınar and Metin has nothing to do with her will be more challenging for Ilgaz than any case he has faced so far... On the way to Zafer's death, the curtains of doubt began to be lifted. Unexpected surprises will arise for the Pars and Eren front, who try to manage the process with transparency so that Ceylin does not misunderstand, on the one hand, and the Yekta front, who manipulates the event, on the other. Ilgaz and Ceylin, who have started to dream of a common future thanks to the support and trust they have received from each other, are on the verge of the biggest break in their relationship ever. Will there be a ray of hope at the end of the tunnel of uncertainty that awaits them?

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Ceylin surprises Ilgaz and decides to give their relationship a new chance. However, in order to continue, she asks him to make a choice. This choice will turn Ilgaz's whole life upside down. On the one hand, the woman he loves, on the other hand, the family he carries with him for a lifetime… The final turning point has been reached in the murder of Zafer. There is only one thing left that is needed for the pieces to slowly come together and light up the whole event night. For the sake of this possibility of enlightenment, surprise meetings will take place and new agreements will be made. However, what they do not calculate is that Yekta has other plans for them. Ilgaz and Ceylin, who want to find the truth and fight for themselves, will have more difficulties than they expected on this road; they will have to come face to face with all the facts that stand in their way and try to ignore them.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Stuck between his family and his love, Ilgaz has made a choice, and neither Ilgaz nor Ceylin can deny the gap between them. While Ceylin is trying to punish the person who murdered her father, Ilgaz's distance is added to this. The smoke screen about the night Zafer was killed has been opened, albeit a little. The move that will corner Pars and Eren, who are trying their best to reveal the truth as soon as possible, will come from an unexpected place. The case, which was pushed into insolvency, seems to turn the lives of many people upside down. A surprise ending awaits Yekta, who has been watching the event from her corner with pleasure until now. In addition to all the difficulties they have experienced, an insidious and unpredictable plan is about to surround Ilgaz and Ceylin. Time is running towards an irreversible danger for them...

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Ceylin is not even aware that she is in danger of death besides her already chaotic life and emotions. Ilgaz, on the other hand, cannot fit anywhere. He is one step away from sensing the danger Ceylin is in. Will Ilgaz and Ceylin be able to get out of this stabbing situation? Yekta Tilmen was almost caught red-handed by the Pars Prosecutor in front of the courthouse. Serdar, who has been wanted as a "witness" for a long time, suddenly leaves Yekta's car and will change the course of the whole game that has been set up until now. With Serdar's speech, unexpected and surprising associations will emerge in the case of Zafer's murder. The obstacle in the way of Ilgaz and Ceylin is not only the danger of death, the shadow of Zafer's death is still on them. What will be the decision they will make at the point of separation, which they have come to with their own choices?

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Ilgaz and Ceylin, whose love for each other wasn't enough for them to be side by side, are now very shaken by their divorce. Moreover, while waiting for the solution of the Yeşim issue, which awaits them, collapsed in the middle of their lives and has not yet been fully clarified... Yekta Tilmen, who has always been the smiling side, has started to open some gaps, albeit small, on the front. On the one hand, while Serdar's dismissal as a suspect with the indictment prepared by Pars is beneficial for him, on the other hand, will he be able to disrupt the unexpected plan prepared against him before it even starts? Ilgaz, who is trying to cope with the pain of separation in his own way, has to deal with the murder of Zafer, which he is close to a solution, on the other hand. In this case, will Ilgaz and Ceylin, whose paths reunite by fate, be able to balance both separating their ways and acting together?

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: The protagonists of the story, which started with a murder in which both of them were hurt by their brothers; Ceylin and Ilgaz, whose separate paths have crossed and united for the last time in their professional lives, are at a turning point that they will never forget in this relationship. Yekta, who has destroyed everyone around her with her actions and is about to fall under the huge wave of anger she has created because of this, awaits a desire for revenge that she has never seen from anyone before her. Çınar, on the other hand, wants to start a new life with the untied knot, but will some incalculable developments allow her to achieve this? The "end" is still far away in Ilgaz and Ceylin's journey, where will the comma put for now throw them away? Where will their love, the authenticity of which neither they nor their families nor their friends doubt, will evolve in a cascade of events that will grow to such an extent that they can never foresee from today?

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Ilgaz and Ceylin, left all the difficulties behind and are living the best moments of their marriage; Yekta, who has lost her reputation, money and wife, has fallen into the streets with no money; Pars has set sail for a new love; Gül, found a new way to keep his anger to go on living; Metin retired; Despite Osman's intention not to give up on their marriage, Aylin is no longer the same; Çınar is angry with his friends and angry with the life he himself has succumbed to; And when Eren finds four bodies in the well one morning... The process of turning enemies into friends and friends into enemies has now begun. Because; "A wire breaks, harmony is cut forever."

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Before Ilgaz could get over the shock of the anonymous note he found, he'll have to face with Ceylin. Since he doesn't want Ceylin involved in this case, he needs to make a very difficult decision that will affect his relationship and the course of the investigation. The team, which has grown closer as a result of their efforts to find Neva's killer, are now facing Pars as they've never seen him before - full of rage and ambition. The balance in their team, that they considered unshakable, is now being tested including the newly formed relationship between Derya and Pars. Yekta, starts hearing warning bells. He is firing its last bullets to reinvent itself... But he goes so far beyond the limits that he once again comes up against Ceylin. Everyone, but most of all Ilgaz and Ceylin, as well as Pars, are making an effort to uncover the truth, that is - the murderer... However, they can't even imagine the unexpected questions and possibillities that this murder will lead them towards...

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: In the meticulously prepared operation, Ilgaz sensed that everything was a trap prepared to lure them into the hotel. The fact that the elevator that Ceylin was supposed to ride reached the lobby in an empty state made everyone uneasy that this plot extended to their personal lives. Stumbling between the death of his brother and the weight of the office of the Attorney General, Pars now has to face the consequences of his decisions. While all the information of the people who were killed and thrown into the well slowly came to light, the fact that the only living witness was abducted from the hospital alarmed everyone. As Ilgaz and Eren make greater strides in their suspicious possibilities, surprise testimonies and secrets will appear before them. The fact that Ceylin acts according to her own truth for the sake of finding the truth, infuriating Ilgaz. A series of events awaits the duo, who try to separate work and love according to the promises they made to each other.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Ilgaz put forward the first theory in the well-murders, which remain a mystery, by saying that "the killer creates a family for himself". Ceylin does not hesitate to research her own thesis by side ways. With the mysterious death of his sister Neva and the murderer not being found, Pars is going downhill psychologically with each passing hour. The end of this slope will lead him to make a choice between his profession and his feelings, what will Pars' choice be? When the identities of all those who were removed from the well became clear, the investigations carried out became even clearer. However, the new suspicions that arise force Ilgaz and Eren to remain vigilant. Eventually they will have to be dragged into a choice they don't want. Ilgaz and Ceylin are working hard in their own way to untie the difficult event knot; However, at the end of the day, with the development that will shake everyone, they have to understand that nothing will be the same as before.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Ceylin has been the target of the well killer. She finds himself in the same place as other abducted people. Ilgaz is not yet aware of this. Ilgaz, who is frantically struggling to catch a vulnerability of the killer, is devastated by the fear of losing Ceylin. Chief Prosecutor Pars has found himself on a dark path to find his sister's killer as soon as possible. Will Ilgaz, Eren and Derya, who see his drift very clearly, be able to calmly restrain Pars' pain? As the new "target family" is revealed, everyone who is locked in, especially Ceylin, has to fight the psychological, manipulative games of the killer. They all have the same question on their minds: Why do we and what does the killer want from us? While everyone is working hard to find Ceylin, Ilgaz is ready to show thousands of times this effort... Like Pars, he has been shot in the heart and has to move very fast in the case. In this way, he will not hesitate to confront even his most loved ones.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Ilgaz mobilized all his might to save Ceylin from the place where she was closed as soon as possible. Ceylin, on the other hand, struggles to survive with those inside. Moreover, now someone she knows, maybe Burak, who will be an ally of Ceylin, has entered. As clues about the well-killer keep coming, the sleeping enemy is in a new collaboration to join the case. At the end of the road, trying to catch up with his old reputation. Yekta's plan will surprise everyone. The case has engulfed everyone's personal lives like a whirlpool. His team, which has been giving everything to the case without sleep and without energy for days, is waiting for unclear evidence to prove the identity of the killer. Ilgaz, who lost his compass without Ceylin, is in search of solid evidence that will completely change the fate of the case with his predictions and intuition. Will the paths he believes have found enable him to find Ceylin and allow the duo to take a deep breath?

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Ilgaz has revealed the identity of the psychopath that everyone is looking for. Now is the time to find the necessary evidence and ensure justice. Ceylin, on the one hand, is trying to get rid of the traces of the trauma she experienced and, on the other hand, she is after the answer to a question that haunts her mind, who killed the taxi driver inside? Yekta, who is one step closer to regaining her former glory days and getting stronger, has annoyed the team enough by getting involved in the case. However, while Yekta is dreaming of reaching her goal, in fact, there are other plans that life has prepared for all of them; Yekta's plan will change direction with a sharp bend. Relieved by the joy of finding Ceylin and being side by side again, Ilgaz awaits an unexpected choice in the finale; This choice puts Ilgaz on a fine line between life and death... This sudden decision he has to make will radically change his life and start a great struggle in which the sides become sharper.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Ilgaz finally found the well killer he had been looking for for days and was forced to shoot Burak involuntarily. Now, on the one hand, the remorse of the possibility of being a murderer, and on the other hand, the criticality of the situation of his dear friend Eren; it will cause him to question himself deeply. Even though everything seems like an obvious "red-handed" operation, there is Yekta on the other side, who is a master at muddying the water all the time. This time, Yekta has added a strong and wealthy business person to her side, and things are actually going as he wishes. Yekta's efforts to bend the event in his favor will bear fruit and blow everyone with an unexpected surprise. Ilgaz, who will be tested both with his own and his friends' reputation, needs Ceylin more than ever. Moreover, this time, not only the two of them, but everyone they love has much more to lose; they will need new plans to cope.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: For Ilgaz, who is fighting with his conscience, being sacked from his job, which is the meaning of his life, has been a great devastation. Will they give in to this situation with Eren and Pars, or will they stay together and defend their rights against Turgut Ali, struggling to find new evidence? Yekta, who seized the opportunity for revenge that he had been waiting for a long time, started to play his cards ruthlessly. On the one hand, while the investigation of the chief inspector from the HSK continues, he is not satisfied with what he has done and starts working on a new plan, and moreover, he is successful. Of course, Ceylin, who always stands by her husband and friends, who are punished as if they were criminals, has a plan to help them too... However, apart from this whole war, a new war is beginning that closely concerns both families, and Ceylin and Ilgaz have no idea about it yet.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: After Serdar's death, everyone was shocked. While Ilgaz tries to figure out how this murder happened, Ceylin rushes to the aid of a friend who is in trouble, unaware of everything. However, on the other hand, she cannot understand the strange behavior of her family, especially Aylin. Yekta Serdar is preparing to wage a new war against this quartet by turning the murder in her favor again, but he is not even aware that a truth that will turn his life upside down is waiting for him. Pars is determined to go after Rafet with the information he got from Turgut Ali. On the other hand, he tries to help Derya because she will face a formidable lawyer in her new case. While Ilgaz and Ceylin strive to reach different realities, they try to live by enjoying the peace they have just attained. However, every new information they learn takes them step by step towards an irreversible destruction...

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: It's time for Ceylin, who pulls the end of the rope, to get answers to her questions. However, all these answers also concern Ilgaz, who is dealing with the Serdar case. A difficult bend awaits Ceylin, who is caught between her family and justice. The reputation of Pars, the Chief Prosecutor, who has barely found a balance in his work and relationship,s about to be shaken by the news of "forbidden love in the courthouse" that has fallen to the press, and he is about to find a solution. On the other hand, Derya-Ceylin has to balance the relationship that has been strained by the Arda incident. A secret from her past will upset Yekta, who dreams of catching the good old days in her new office. The paths of Ilgaz and Ceylin, who are rapidly marching to the same conclusion from different sides of the case, are about to cross once again. Every knowledge they acquire will turn into a big hump on their back.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Although both Ceylin and Ilgaz have held one end of the ropes leading to the murder from two separate branches; there are too many lies and unknowns waiting for them to reach the truth. Both are unaware that they will be greatly disappointed with their families. On the one hand, while Yekta is doing everything in his power to complicate the team regarding the murder of Serdar, on the other hand, he has to fight against everyone who presses him, especially Haluk. Pars and Derya come to a very different turning point than Pars imagined. Merdan devises a new plan to keep the two families together no matter what. While the chain of events is drifting towards a disaster, it's time the family, which is firmly stuck in themselves and on the path of justice, to make a decision. However, this decision will cause irreparable wounds in Ilgaz and Ceylin.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: With Parla's confession, Ceylin finds herself under a much heavier burden than she can handle, even if she has no fault. On the one hand, there is the man she loves and her keen belief in justice, and on the other, her family. Everyone, especially Gül and Aylin, is experiencing a great panic. Now, they all have to manage to skillfully keep their secrets and come up with an urgent action plan. This situation will lead the Erguvan family to dangerous paths. Will Derya, who is trying to solve Arda's case, find a surprising way out of the deadlock in the damaged relationship with Pars? What attitude will Yekta take in the face of Ömer, who now claims to have a son in the new order he has established? Ilgaz, who feels trapped in everything that is happening, takes Ceylin's hand and takes her on a different and peaceful trip, where they can breathe together. The meaning of this escape is very different for both of them, and neither of them know what awaits them in the end.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Ilgaz and Ceylin, who leave their problems in Istanbul and go to Cappadocia for a little getaway, are not told the facts. In addition to what Ceylin did not tell Ilgaz, an anonymous e-mail awaits them that will change the course of the event. The Erguvan family is doing their best not to add Parla to their losses so far. For this cause, Aylin and Osman take a dangerous risk and a new decision is added to the decisions taken on behalf of Parla. For Derya, who accepted Pars' marriage proposal, the problems in the Arda file still remain. Yekta's complaint against Derya and Haluk's meeting with journalist Berkant will be the beginning of brand new events. Ceylin and Ilgaz, who have sworn not to hide anything from each other, are facing great difficulties in Istanbul, where they will return after a short break. The e-mail sent to Ilgaz will bring new realities and tensions behind it, which will push both of them to some crossroads.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: The conflict between Ilgaz and Ceylin grows more and more because of the murder of Serdar. Ilgaz, who almost picked everyone up at the airport, has to make the most difficult decision of his life. Ceylin, who has been tested between her conscience and her belief in justice, through her family, wants to protect her loved ones no matter what, even if the end of the road seems dark. However, the choices she will make to keep her family together and the lies she will tell will most often tie her hands. Derya, who started the wedding preparations, is waiting for a new murder case for the prosecutor. The death of journalist Berkant in front of Haluk completely reverses the balance between him and Yekta. Ceylin and Ilgaz come to a point where they do not deserve at all because of the values they cannot give up and the situations they cannot change; this deeply saddens everyone around them, and they have a trial in which the decision that come will affect everyone.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: There are some situations in which even the greatest love is not enough to save; Ilgaz and Ceylin now have to learn to stay away from each other through a bitter experience. They are confronted indirectly in a new case. Two grieving families, devastated by the bride's disappearance on the wedding day, fall like a bomb in the middle of the agenda of Ilgaz, Ceylin, Pars and Eren. However, there are many things hidden behind this incident, which seems to be a simple case case of disappearance, and it will be very difficult to open the smoke screen on it. While Yekta is dealing with Haluk's case, he finds an unexpected supporter and this opens new doors for him. While Çınar promises to protect the trust left by her grandfather, a new way of life awaits Merdan. Despite all the problems between them, it's more important for Ilgaz and Ceylin reach the truth as soon as possible. However, a phone call to Ceylin will change the whole course of the event and will be a harbinger of a great danger.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Ceylin finds herself in a new dilemma. The threatening phone call he received in connection with the case will create a new tension with Ilgaz, with whom she is already at odds. Will the sense of protecting the man she loves on the one hand, and the reflex of reaching the truth in the case as soon as possible, on the other hand, be enough to keep them together? In the investigation of the "bride found dead on the wedding day", Ilgaz and Eren are after exactly what happened on the wedding day. With every truth revealed in the case, a strange web of relationships is revealed. While Yekta Tilmen tries to get to know his son Ömer even better, Ömer's unpredictable behavior will surprise him day by day. Ilgaz, who has faced many threats due to his profession so far, is concerned with not compromising justice in any way. But no one, including Ilgaz, could have foreseen that the scale of the threat would be so large and serious.Increasing threats will change the entire course of the case.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: The bomb, which was placed in Ilgaz's car and detonated in front of everyone in the garden of the police, created a great shock to everyone. No one he loves, especially Ilgaz, is safe. The only issue for Ilgaz is now to find the truth behind this murder. In the "dead bride" case, it is now crucial to find out who committed the murder and the name behind the bomb and the threats. Both the bride's and groom's families are coded as major suspects. But as the groom's lawyer, familiar faces suddenly become involved; Yekta Tilmen and his son Ömer… Ilgaz, Eren and Ceylin, who went over each clue one by one; They decide to solve the mystery about Çetin. Aylin will be the most upsetting person on this path. Ilgaz and Ceylin have to stand side by side to look out for each other in this predicament; their love, which they are trying to bury in the deepest part of their hearts, causes them to worry about each other. However, the threats will not end and Ilgaz's patience will be severely tested.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: When Defne's bag is found at the crime scene, Ilgaz's world falls apart. Moreover, Metin's situation is critical, and the magnitude of the evil that this gang dealing with them can do now makes everyone nervous. Resolving the "dead bride" case as soon as possible is also very important in terms of finding Defne. Ilgaz, Ceylin and the people around them put their lives in their teeth and focus on solving the incident as soon as possible. While the secrets of Çetin, are revealed one by one, the biggest reflection of this is the relationship between Osman and Aylin. Eyüp, who attracts Çınar's attention, unexpectedly comes with a move that will be in the middle of events. Ceylin is the biggest supporter of Ilgaz, who believes that all kinds of roads can be walked when it comes to "protecting her loved ones", but it will not be easy to find Defne. They are faced with a more serious and dangerous gang than they anticipated, and Ilgaz falls into a great dilemma to save Defne.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Defne's video deeply hurt everyone, especially Ilgaz and Ceylin. What begins with a small spark is about to turn into an irrepressible fire. Capturing the end of the rope, Ilgaz will mobilize all his might to pull it all out as soon as possible. The "dead bride" case has been solved, but no one has any intention of letting go of Salim, the groom. Every piece of information from him is important in finding Defne. There is still a big veil of secrecy behind Salim. The great power he has behind him is full of question marks. While everyone is united in the search for Defne, Çınar cooperates with Eyüp, who speaks to him as an eyewitness. With Salim's guilt clearly revealed, Yekta and Ömer hatch a new plan to exploit Ilgaz's desperation in their favor. Working with all the forces of justice and security, Ilgaz, Pars, Eren and Ceylin have to make quick decisions and hold on to every scrap of information. A very painful event awaits them on a road they set out without seeing the end.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Ilgaz is making a great effort to find Defne as soon as possible. Time is running out. Everyone around him, especially Ceylin, helps him with all his might. Now they will have a big clue. The deaths of Salim and Rıdvan have turned all the rules upside down. The consequences of Pars' impulsive decision are rapidly leading him to great destruction. On the other hand, Metin's critical life condition continues, and Çınar questions his brother's decisions. On the front of Yekta and Ömer, who were involved in the incident as clients by the groom, Ömer is in a hurry to play an unexpected card. There will be an unexpected reaction from Ceylin to this move, which will redefine the fronts. Despite the problems between them, the Ilgaz-Ceylin couple, who are trying to reach a solution together even in this case, which has reached great threats to all members of their families, stand right on a crossroads. They have to make a decision in divorce case.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Bringing his family together intact, Ilgaz intends not to leave the Balkan mafia case without a complete solution. His biggest goal is to bring down this gang, which harms everyone in some way and has a hard time, and to keep his family together again. Danger bells are ringing for Özge, she has fallen into a big game that touches everyone, but she will get an unexpected companion who can get her out of this grip. The successive death news has devastated everyone. It is up to the youth and Merdan to fix Defne's psychology. He was able to intervene in Yekta Ilgaz's file through an old acquaintance. It's time for Yekta, who learned the game that was set up for her thanks to Ömer, to make a plan to counterattack. Ilgaz is after a big step to stay together with Ceylin after a lot of hardships. After all the evil that has befallen them, they will have to hold hands even tighter than ever.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: The chaotic state of the Anemon operation has put everyone in great anxiety. The news of death coming incessantly will require new decisions in front of Ilgaz and Ceylin and to face the consequences of these decisions. While the vacancy of the Attorney General is closing with a Deputy Attorney General, the new person to come is a matter of curiosity for everyone. The important thing for the team, who could not reach Pars anyway is to keep Derya calm and out of the events as well as pursue the new evidence found.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: The horror behind Pars's disappearance and Igor's threat is the biggest burden that has ever been placed on Ilgaz's shoulders. He has to act fast, making a radical decision to keep his family and friends safe before anyone gets hurt. But in order to destroy the threat forever, he must find Igor's real tongs, the hitman. Ceylin is his biggest supporter on this path, and she does her best to solve his stuckness and despair. The truth about Pars deeply injures and destroys everyone, especially Derya. Yekta, who learns what happened, is unaware of the plans built on this move as she prepares to open new cards in her battle with Ilgaz and Ceylin. While trying to find Igor's hitman, the walls they hit make Ilgaz and Ceylin despair. However, an offer of help from an unexpected person leads Ilgaz to a risky and dangerous choice between his loved ones and his profession. Moreover, this choice will cause a new struggle to begin in the lives of Ilgaz and Ceylin.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Ilgaz's decision to end the threats made to his loved ones as soon as possible leaves him face-to-face with great slander. He saved his family's life, but now his profession and all the values he believes in are in danger. Where will the finely laid paths to scribble it end? The file of Ilgaz, one of his most trusted prosecutors, came before Turgut Ali, who came as the Deputy Chief Prosecutor. However, Özcan, who is assigned to look after this file and is quite the opposite, has to work in partnership with the prosecutor. The robustness of the evidence, one by one, that Ilgaz is guilty makes it impossible for both prosecutors to believe Ceylin, who is trying hard to prove the contrary. All hope of Ilgaz and Ceylin is in Ceylin's defense; but what time will bring them is as uncertain as ever.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: The systematic slander against Ilgaz led to his arrest at great speed. Ilgaz, who has never compromised his truth and honesty under any circumstances, has to illuminate these crimes as soon as possible. Yekta, who is following Ömer's true story, realizes that she is in danger as a result of the lies she catches one after the other. In the absence of Ilgaz, she thinks she has no choice but to cooperate with Ceylin and Eren. Ömer, on the other hand, continues to deftly erase his own name after his crimes and slanders.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: At first, thanks to the great sacrifice of Ceylin, Ilgaz is acquitted of the false accusations against him. However, those who unjustly accused Ilgaz will not stop. Now that their plans have been foiled, the enemy must also deal with a stronger Ilgaz who they can no longer keep behind bars. After Yekta's cooperation with Ceylin and Eren, Ömer is taken into custody and finds himself facing Özcan and Turgut Ali. Now it's his turn to defend and clear his name. Yekta's change of sides seems to have ruined all of Ömer's plans, but as always, Ömer finds another way out.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Ilgaz's search is about to end at the point that will destroy his life; his fate is at the end of the barrel of the gun held by Turgut Ali, whom he sees as the guardian of justice. Before he is shot with bullets that will be the biggest betrayal of his life, there are completely different truths he will learn about Turgut Ali. As soon as Ceylin hears that Parla is missing, she immediately takes action. However, this path ends in such a way that Eren and Ceylin find themselves struggling in a painful unknown. Ceylin, who receives the painful news of Ilgaz from Eren, is almost dead in spirit. But at the same time, she is accused of something she didn't do, all the while burdened with a secret she must keep.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: The bitter end that no one could have imagined has come true. Ilgaz's news has devastated Ceylin, who is being held as a murder suspect. Her desire to see and touch the man she loves for the last time is between the lips of the police and judicial authorities conducting the investigation. Metin's heart cannot bear the sudden loss of his son any longer and he is hospitalized. This leaves Çınar with a burden bigger than anything she has ever carried. While Ömer awaits a development he never anticipated, Turgut Ali is determined to advance his escape plan step by step. Eren, who has withdrawn from Ilgaz's file, is in a hurry to get Ceylin out as soon as possible. Catching the real enemy unnoticed and exonerating Ceylin is his biggest professional and conscientious test. Even though he cooperates with Yekta, with whom he has been distant from the very beginning...

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: While life tosses Ceylin and Ilgaz with waves in a sea they have never known, time has shaped their souls completely differently. Now they need one more miracle to close the distance between them. But in the meantime, life has prepared new surprises for everyone. A new era has begun where enmities will turn into friendships, love will turn into hate, and uncertainties will be revealed...

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Ceylin brings Nil to the police station to take his statement. However, what comes next is quite challenging for both Ilgaz and Ceylin. While struggling with the pain they carry inside, they also have to fulfill their professional duties. And this situation brings them face to face again because they have different ideas. Yekta is about to learn that Nil is hiding more secrets than he ever imagined. There is a reason behind Merdan's move to the nursing home that no one can guess. Çınar and Parla have difficulty ignoring some problems in their relationship. Ilgaz chases after the evidence he finds and discovers an unexpected truth about Nil. This situation pushes him towards Ceylin again. No matter what happens, they can't break away from each other and meet at the same point; the place where it all started, the place that placed this pain in their hearts. However, the "truth" is very different and far away from what they expected.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Everyone is clustered around a single question and wants to find the answer as soon as possible, no matter what; "Where is Mercan?" Mercan's disappearance causes deep wounds in the lives of everyone, especially Ceylin and Ilgaz. But trying to stay together while struggling with the loss of their child is very difficult for both of them. Crushed under the weight of the shadow of the past, the couple will confront each other in an attempt to clear the fog a little bit. Meanwhile, efforts to find Mercan continue. The roles of Can, Nadide, Efe, Nil, Dilek, Nil, Dilek, and Macit in Mercan's disappearance, who have quickly entered the list of suspects, begin to get rid of uncertainty day by day. Ceylin and Ilgaz learn to survive on the basis of their despair, but an unexpected surprise will upset all the balances in their lives, and everyone will seek the answer to a new question.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: The package left at the door is more than enough to reinforce Ceylin's long-standing belief that Mercan is alive. However, this child's t-shirt carries many questions. As Ilgaz and Ceylin pursue these questions, instead of reaching a solution, they are confronted with suspects they have only just realized. Everyone tries to go through everything once more to reach the end of the rope they have grasped the end of and find Mercan. While Merdan is making a new stage in his friendship with Macit, Yekta is ready to plunge into darkness he would never want to get involved in just to help Ceylin.  Ilgaz and Ceylin have to put their differences aside and pursue every scrap of information as if they were a family again. Everyone's efforts are rewarded, especially theirs; at the end of the day, they will go after the truth that has been underneath them all this time but that they have not seen, and both of them will be stunned.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: For Ceylin and Ilgaz, who are clinging to every possibility in their search for Mercan, the possibilities that have been constantly bifurcating and increasing until now are slowly diminishing and pushing them toward the truth. Their first goal is to unravel the mystery behind Efe, but on the way, they are confronted with a shocking reality. Everyone continues to mobilize in their own ways to search for Mercan. Tuğçe uses all her determination to find Mercan and reaches a new piece of information. As Yekta faces the fact that Kadir is much more dangerous than he imagined, Can and Osman will be joined by someone new. As Eren continues to watch the statements of the suspects on the beach that day, he realizes a detail that will shock everyone. Ceylin and Ilgaz find themselves in an unexpected and dangerous situation due to the illegal choices they made to find Mercan. What they don't know is that they are facing the reality of where Mercan is.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: An unexpected accident awaits Ilgaz and Ceylin on their journey to find Mercan. While they are waiting to reunite and hug their daughter safely as soon as possible, this obstacle they will face and what will happen next will be enough to shake them both. Dilek's truth touching Eren's own life as he pursues Mercan, and the details told will be enough to shatter his world. Yekta, who is determined to take responsibility for Ceylin, will once again have to make an alliance with the darkness, even if he doesn't want to. Will Çınar, who intends to make himself shine in Parla's eyes by doing business with Osman and Can, find a place for himself at the new table? While trying to reach Filiz, Ilgaz and Ceylin will encounter a new collaboration that they did not expect on Dilek's side. It is very close that the door to happy days will be opened for Ilgaz, who is at the top of the list of those who will not forgive himself regarding Mercan, and Ceylin, who risks everything to find her daughter.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: The discovery of Mercan has enlightened everyone's world, especially Ilgaz and Ceylin. A great effort awaits Ceylin and Ilgaz to meet their daughter again, to understand her and to become a family again. Yekta, who gets more involved in Kadir's darkness each time, has to make a big decision. Osman, Can and Çınar, who still don't understand what they are getting into, are pressured by the tasks they need to complete. On the other hand, Merdan will pursue an unpleasant truth about Defne. The steps Nil will take in the Filiz and Dilek case and their results will astonish everyone. Ceylin, who is tested by the absence of her daughter, will have to give a big test about herself. Ceylin and Ilgaz's journey, which will not end only with finding Mercan, has just begun. Separating their daughter from Filiz, physically and emotionally, marks a very difficult process. Now they have to unite and fight for their daughter more than ever.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Determined not to let Filiz into their lives again, Ceylin's plan for this purpose will lead her into a dilemma. Yekta, who finds Nil on the other side every time, will try to solve this problem once and for all. At the end of the day, Yekta, who is already in trouble with Kadir, and thus the trio of Osman, Can, Çınar, will be shaken with a big shock on their own fronts. A journey she could never have foreseen awaits Defne, who first falls under the radar of Çınar and then her grandfather. On the other hand, Mercan, who is trying to adapt to her new life, is awaited by a curious group of relatives who have been longing for years and are eager to embrace her as soon as possible. Ilgaz knows very well what Ceylin is capable of doing when she is desperate. Ceylin's impulsive walk alone is enough to anger Ilgaz. Will the happy days in which they have to stand side by side for their daughter be a harbinger of even happier days, or is every moment about to turn into a nightmare?

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Ceylin, who breathes a sigh of relief when Mercan is found and settles in the house, will find herself in a conscience examination with the weight of the process and what it makes her feel. The incident that happened to her when she was in her third year at university and that she wants to go back and fix will be enough to confuse her present. Ceylin will also remember those who are no longer alive, such as Engin, Zafer, and İnci, and will come face to face with Yekta's old, dark side. On the other hand, the new fatal case that shakes the police department will drop like a bomb on everyone's agenda. Can's death has shown Kadir's determination and ruthlessness. Ilgaz and Ceylin, who have taken it for granted how much they love each other and that one is incomplete without the other, have to deal with the ghosts of the past together and by joining forces. Ceylin is unaware that a shocking and unexpected ending awaits her as she digs into her past.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Ceylin chooses a difficult path she has never experienced before to save Tülin, who is about to take her last breath in her arms. In order to reveal the truth as soon as possible, she will go on a journey, hand in hand with Ilgaz, going over every detail over and over again. Osman makes a spontaneous plan with Çınar to prevent the body in his garden from being noticed by others. The unknown file, which started with the actor shooting himself on the set of the series, will keep Metin, Eren and Tuğçe very busy. On the other hand, Yekta is waiting for a confrontation with the situations that he hid from Ceylin in the Tülin incident and never wanted to be revealed and avoided talking about. With the continuous new events, Ilgaz will unravel the knot and begin to see the whole. At the end of the day, he will be shocked that the point where the rope is resolved somehow puts Ceylin and Mercan under threat.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Ceylin unknowingly comes face to face with the murderer they are looking for. Mercan's unintentional stay in the middle of the incident will be enough to drive Ilgaz crazy. Moreover, what Okan wants Ilgaz to do to put an end to this situation in which he holds everyone in Tilmen at gunpoint is not likely to be solved easily. The police, headed by Ilgaz, will have to blockade Tilmen Hukuk with all its units. Osman and Çınar, who are barely able to collect Kadir's money, hope to pay off their debts and cut off the relationship. On the other hand, Osman is unaware of Aylin's wrath that awaits him, and it is time for them to confront each other. All family members are on alert for Ceylin and Mercan. Ceylin will make a great effort from the inside, Ilgaz from the outside, for Mercan, whom they are trying to heal from her past wounds, to prevent her from experiencing new ones. But at the end of the day, an event that no one can predict will be enough to distract everyone.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: In Yekta's absence, Kadir makes an even more difficult request of Osman and Çınar to settle his debts. The duo will be left on their own with their non-existent business skills, but the decisions they make along the way will turn everyone's world upside down. While Tuğçe and Efe are in a full-fledged rapprochement away from prying eyes, Parla is waiting for a back story about Çınar that she has never known until now. A new forensic case will fall into the laps of Ilgaz and Ceylin, who return to their ranks of prosecutors and lawyers like the old days. The events that begin with the woman found unconscious and unidentified are the first spill of a river that is on its way out of its bed, and if left unchecked, it is likely to sweep away all those in its path.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: At the table in Ceylin and Ilgaz's house, the tension over who will eat the marked pizza is at its peak. Osman, who is watching them anxiously, has a decision to make without letting anyone know anything. A story that will shatter their hearts awaits Ceylin, Ilgaz, and the security crew, who are determined to follow Seçil's steps. With the horrifying details that will emerge, it will be more difficult than ever to unravel this case that is shrouded in so many unknowns. It is now Yekta's turn to intervene for Osman and Çınar, whom Kadir has taken in his grasp. On the other hand, someone else they never expected will see this downhill slide and come after them. While Ilgaz mobilizes all his forensic power to solve the case of Seçil and the growing case, Ceylin will pursue Seçil's story in her own way. At the end of the day, Ceylin and Ilgaz, who are invincible when they combine their powers from their own fields, are waiting for executions they never expected.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Ceylin and Ilgaz are met with unexpected deaths in the case sparked by Seçil's story. On their separate paths, they come across an organized evil network they have never seen before. Turned into puppets in Kadir's hands, Osman and Çınar face difficult times ahead. With the involvement of Merdan and then Ceylin, everything will have to be revealed as it is. The decisions that must be made at the end of the day will shake everyone's world, especially Aylin and Parla. In the case of Seçil, which leads back to Kadir, this time, it is Kadir's turn to make a move. As enemies and friends become clearer and clearer, will Kadir be able to use his connections to exonerate himself and his actions? Bringing down the organization, whose roots go deeper than they ever imagined, will be one of the biggest tests of justice for Ilgaz. Will the war he will wage inside and outside, despite all kinds of obstructions, be enough to reinforce his belief in "justice" and give everyone the end they deserve?

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Ilgaz's organization operation, in which he even confronts the chief prosecutor, has come to an end, and everyone, including the chief prosecutor, has been unmasked. The entire police force, especially Ilgaz and Eren, will mobilize to catch the fugitive Nadide and Kadir as soon as possible. On the other hand, Efe's surprise phone call will upset all the balances, and at the same time, it will be enough to give him the slap of his life. Osman and Çınar, who no longer hold back from telling what they know about the Kadir case, have problems to face in their personal lives; both with their families and with themselves... Yekta, Ceylin, and Parla will do everything they can to provide legal services to the victims of the organization. A brand new turn awaits Ceylin and Ilgaz's relationship, where whichever one of them falls, the other one reaches out a hand, grasps it tightly, and pulls them back to their feet each time.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Ilgaz has Kadir, the cause of his father's death, firmly cornered. The fairest choice he tries to find within himself does not seem to be enough to cool everyone's hearts. In addition, the case of Meltem, one of the victimized girls of the organization that was brought down, drops like a bomb on Ceylin and Ilgaz's agenda. After the collapse of their business with Osman, Parla's departure, and the death of his father, Çınar is now waiting for a voice message from his father. After the final confrontation with his brother Ilgaz, which will bring things to a breaking point, Çınar is waiting for a journey away from everyone and into himself. Ceylin and Ilgaz are faced with the Meltem case with all its unknowns. Their professional separation will lead them to pursue clues from different places. At the end of the day, the truth that both of them come close to finding will affect their own realities and make their differences more visible.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Ilgaz is trying to find out who killed Meltem's father from home as soon as possible. However, the fact that Ceylin, who was following the same case, knew more than him and thought that she was hiding it from him made him angry. Their professional separation will bring out the tension between them. Help comes from an unexpected place for Osman, who is trying to find a new way and hold on to life. On the other hand, Merdan has his own plans. Çınar's disappearance worries everyone, especially Ilgaz and Parla. Looking for his own way, Çınar finds himself in a completely different world that no one knows about. While Ceylin deals with the hospital case with Yekta, she also mobilizes all her wealth to support Meltem and her family, who have already been victimized. In the case where Ilgaz is in control from moment to moment, it is difficult for both of them to move forward by hiding what they found from each other.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: While a child being guilty puts Ilgaz between conscience and justice, the new "missing child" file that Ceylin receives will escalate the tensions between Ilgaz and her even further. Moreover, the investigating officer in the case is Ceylin's ex-boyfriend, Fırat. The newly appointed supervisor at the police station, Kubilay, will change the established order of everyone, especially Eren. On the other hand, the new prosecutor assigned to the courthouse, Ertuğrul, brings a wind that is beyond the usual even before he arrives. Despite all the differences between Ceylin and Ilgaz, their relationship is in danger. Their marriage, already walking on a thin line, has been wounded with the growth of their professional conflicts. Now, with the uncertainty of Ceylin's past, the dark clouds that have settled over them make it even more difficult to defeat them and stand side by side again.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Ilgaz's conversation has stirred unexpected emotions within Ceylin. She finds herself questioning whether she is truly happy with the life she's leading and the person she has become due to fate's twists and turns. She feels torn between what she has expressed to Ilgaz and what remains unsaid. The discovery of Yiğit's body has sent shockwaves through everyone. The entire family is now under suspicion. As Ceylin endeavors to unravel the family's secrets, she will also come to realize that even Yekta, who is seemingly close to her, is keeping secrets from her. Merdan is on the brink of accessing Kadir's hidden fortune through his plan with Osman. Kürşat's news of death will serve as the catalyst for a completely different path for Çınar. Fırat's forced involvement in the Yiğit case has created a rift in Ceylin and Ilgaz's relationship. While their relationship has been tested before, this time, the distance between them seems harder to bridge.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Ceylin has chosen to accept herself as she is in the war within herself. Moreover, now that the prosecutor İclal is standing right next to her and Ilgaz, with all the mystery of Ilgaz's past... The curtain of mystery behind Kadir's death is about to be revealed. İclal is the first name that the prosecutor sees as a suspect and orders an operation, which will shock everyone. Ceylin, who wants to reveal the truth as soon as possible, will choose dangerous paths and leave herself and Yekta in a difficult situation. Left alone with a situation he never wanted, Çınar is faced with the opposing demands of those in the association. Ceylin and Ilgaz's relationship, which has become stronger under all kinds of difficult conditions and situations, is on the eve of a completely different turning point. While they can heal each other in every difficulty, their fate is preparing tests for them that they never expected.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Ceylin and Ilgaz were trying to resolve their tense relationship when Iclal's arrival hit their agenda like a bomb. Witnessing the conversation between Ilgaz and Iclal from the interrogation room has left Ceylin shaken, expecting a back story she has never heard before. The events that started with Yiğit's death and escalated with the murder of his brother Mustafa, who was a secret witness, have become increasingly complicated. In the Kaya family, who has not yet overcome the loss of their father, things are still unsettled. After Merdan was arrested on suspicion of killing Kadir, all arrows are now pointing at Çınar as the suspect. Ceylin, who doesn't hesitate to use any means necessary for her loved ones, is facing an impossible situation. Caught between the promises she made to Ilgaz, the need to save Çınar, the truth-seeking Iclal, and her family, she is stuck. And this time, with Yekta also involved in lifting the stone for Çınar...

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Ceylin, in her quest to find and rescue Çınar, has come face to face with her own past. On the other hand, Ilgaz, devastated by an unexpected betrayal, is also searching for Çınar. The bitter truth that unites Ceylin and Ilgaz at the end of their journey will be enough to shake the entire family. With the murders of Kadir and Mustafa, all unanswered questions have converged around the "association". Ilgaz and İclal must collaborate on their separate investigations and research. However, at the end of the day, the revelation that Ceylin and Yekta are involved with the association will open up a brand new mystery that will make both cases forgettable. For Ceylin and Ilgaz, who have faced every kind of pain from those closest to them, it is time to loosen some familial ties. Meanwhile, the time has come for them and the whole family to come together again; Mercan's first birthday... However, today, when everyone seems happy, heralds the beginning of the unhappiest days for some.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: İclal's surprise visit and intimidation to Ceylin on Mercan's birthday surprised her. The paths that Yekta and Ceylin have taken suddenly become a nightmare for both of their professional lives. The incident, which seems like an ordinary judicial case at first, will hit Ilgaz's agenda like a bomb, with great mysteries behind it. Meanwhile, a murder case at the police station will shock everyone. While Eren is drawn to passive duties at the police station, a familiar face will arrive and he will suddenly find himself in the middle of all events. On the one hand, Ilgaz is working hard after his file, and on the other hand, Ceylin is trying to cover everyone's tracks in her own ways... While they are trying to make the lives of everyone around them better to the extent that they can intervene, they are unaware of the plan of fate. A discovery pursued without anyone's knowledge is about to throw everyone into a huge darkness.

videos.title: Episode 87
