videos.overview: Ceylin finds herself defending Yekta in a peace court, while Ilgaz is on a quest to find out who died in the house that was broken into for theft. Efe has a severed head of unknown origin, and Eren has dusty old files. Until everyone's agenda changes irreversibly with Tuğçe's return... Eren sees Kubilay, who has locked his daughter in the field and himself at the table, as the primary culprit of the events. His steps taken in anger will lead to the closing of many doors for him. Meanwhile, Yekta, who is dragged into a professional deadlock with Iclal's arrival, awaits his own marriage. Ceylin and Ilgaz mobilize all their resources and efforts for Tuğçe. On the other hand, they must find a way to control Eren, whom they think will not be able to maintain his composure, stand by him, and give him the truth. However, what they do not know is that the revenge blade, which is slowly being sharpened, has already been drawn from its sheath...

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Ilgaz and the police have found the scene of Tuğçe's incident and are chasing after details. The smallest clue they find, the bits of information they gather, will lead them to unexpected places. The homicide department is particularly mobilized, with all units on high alert. Eren has been cut off from the police, as well as all possible updates. With all his determination, he must investigate his daughter's case parallel to the official investigation. The anonymous attackers are about to take on a tangible form for Eren. Ceylin wants to be involved in Tuğçe's investigation with Yekta. Their independent sources and methods outside of the police force could change the course of the investigation. Ceylin and Ilgaz are speeding towards uncovering the details of the case by combining their efforts. However, they are unaware that a third path has already come into play. At the end of the day, all intertwining roads will converge on Tuğçe, who lies in a hospital bed, unaware of everything.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Ceylin, Ilgaz, and the police rush to the hospital, thinking that Tuğçe is in danger. It's only a matter of time before they come face to face with a criminal they've never known before, who has infiltrated even those closest to Tuğçe. The police, along with all units, are working tirelessly day and night for their colleague Tuğçe. Meanwhile, Eren, empowered by his collaboration with Efe, is determined to go all the way. In this adventure, unexpected and brand-new allies will join him. While Yekta tries to thaw the ice with İclal, Laçin will change her plans with a counterattack. As Osman slowly moves towards his dream path with Zümrüt, Aylin also follows Zümrüt on her own. Having made significant progress in shedding light on what happened to Tuğçe and capturing the culprits, Ceylin and Ilgaz inevitably link the connected murders to a single person: Eren. They are facing a major interrogation by their closest friends.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Ilgaz, the police and the courthouse captured the fugitives involved in the Tuğçe incident dead, whom they were pursuing. Ilgaz is determined to follow the question he is afraid of hearing the answer to, to the end, and not to err on the scales of justice. As Tuğçe slowly comes to her senses, she will burst into tears with Efe's big surprise. As soon as Osman divorces Aylin, he finds himself with Zümrüt, being drawn step by step into a dark plan that he does not know about. On the other hand, he makes another move to corner Laçin, whose anger is increasing. With a new development, Ceylin suddenly finds herself in the middle of the chaos of the case of children poisoned at school. The suspicion of "Eren", which started with Ilgaz and Ceylin and increased in everyone, now makes it necessary to take Eren to the stand. Eren's striking words and perspective on events shake everyone deeply.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Ilgaz fell right into the heat of the fatal accident in front of the hospital. Ceylin, on the other hand, found herself in turmoil in the school case; Children are transported to the hospital one by one. Events await both of them, in which they take their steps into great unknowns. On the other hand, their wedding anniversary has come. Ilgaz and Eren are looking for concrete evidence in the new case they are working on together. However, their inability to reach the truth points to a case that is about to be closed as "unknown perpetrator". Despite all the burden of the case, Ceylin is also trying to find a form of defense with Yekta to get Çınar a trial without arrest. With İclal's acceptance, Yekta enters into a dangerous game with Bülent Kısmetov. While Ceylin and Ilgaz's romantic time alone strengthens their relationship even more; The enemy who will take Ilgaz hostage in five days is waiting for his time in a corner.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Ilgaz, together with Eren, is making a great effort to bring the real criminal to justice. The murder file brought by Eren, which will expire, will be enough to cloud the present while digging into the past. On the other hand, Ceylin is advancing rapidly in the school case and is trying to catch the teacher who is chasing her. With the revelation of Rafet, Yekta creates a new road map in his relationship with Bülent. Osman, on the other hand, embarks on a surprise plan that will save both Zümrüt and his own life. Ceylin, together with Yekta, pursues the only clue they have to prove Çınar's innocence. After Ilgaz and Ceylin's wedding anniversary celebration, they are looking for a way to make the most of their upcoming holidays. But it is only a matter of time before the psychopath waiting in ambush takes action to kidnap Ilgaz. The belief in good days that they dream of with hope is about to turn into a nightmare at any moment.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Ilgaz's determined pursuit of Yeliz quickly draws her into a trap. Very difficult times await Ceylin, who pays close attention to every step Ilgaz takes throughout the day. Moreover, there is a Mercan at home who asks about Ilgaz and is constantly talking... On the other hand, for Çınar, whose hearing day has arrived, Dilan, who is the key to getting out of prison, must be found as soon as possible and persuaded to testify. Yekta's plan to capture Bülent is about to go wrong. Alarm bells are ringing loudly for Yekta, who is cornered and now it is his turn to act. Ilgaz is face to face with the murderer, who asks how he wants his death to be and demands an answer; It is as if he is looking into the eyes of his own death. In a world where loved ones are not with them, every answer carries great meaninglessness. His choice will take him on an unexpected, unknown journey, far from everyone.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: The entire courthouse and police department to find Ilgaz as soon as possible; mobilized with all its units. Everyone shares the slightest clue they have and continues to investigate rapidly from all sides. Unaware of all this, Ilgaz finds himself in the waves while looking for a way to escape. While Ceylin is tested by Ilgaz's absence, on the other hand, she has to keep the family together, especially not to make Mercan feel anything. Moreover, in all this effort, Çınar's court date has come and there is no one other than Ceylin who can take part in the case. Yekta is about to make his final shot in the dangerous Bülent game and settle accounts for his past with İclal. Ilgaz and Ceylin, who have come out of many troubles together, maybe less but always stronger, are left with a question that is difficult to answer.

videos.title: Episode 95 (Final)
videos.overview: An unidentified body found in a container; Metin and Eren standing over the body... İnci and Engin who came to the courthouse to celebrate Ceylin's birthday... Ilgaz Kaya, the prosecutor who was called to the scene; who quietly passed by the Ceylins... Everyone is as they should be, as they are remembered; but everything is different... This time Ceylin and Ilgaz are suspects in the same murder! Ceylin and Ilgaz are a couple who have been brought together by many family secrets around a murder! A love story tied with invisible threads that tighten and tighten as they untie the knots... A corpse that appears in their garden in the city where they go to start a brand new life, as if to underline that they cannot escape their fate... Perhaps a curse... Do two souls searching for each other, unaware of each other for a lifetime, always intersect at some place, at some time? Does everything end where it begins? Or does everything begin in order to end?
